what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Senegal, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2024, the latest year with a figure, IDMC counted 5922 people displaced by conflict and violence.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal with the MFDC in 2011.
IDMC's disaster records for Senegal list floods.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 24000 in 2009 to 5922 in 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2018.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 1541 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Senegal.
